I wrote `priorities.csv` in the working directory with 18 rows. Tickets T-105 and T-115 are closed, so they're left out.

Two matching calls you might want to check:
- **Whole-word matching:** "refunds" (T-107 subject) and "Refunded" (T-117 subject) don't count as `refund`. Both tickets still get P3 because their bodies contain "refund" as a whole word. "Breakdown" and "Downtime" don't count as `down`.
- **Rule order:** the `@acme-intern.be` rule comes before the outage rule, so T-103 and T-119 are P4 even though they mention an outage.
